live_payload_bytes_by_space: Historical raw key: sum of live handleEntry.size per space, INCLUDING header/extent; not cumulative allocation bytes or user-payload-only bytes.
stats.Allocations: Collector allocation charge count, not necessarily one live handle per charge for compiler-proof paths.
old_heap_fixture: 8192 * 8192 bytes of user array payload retained, plus object headers; each ephemeral scalar has one i64 field; exact live extents and charge delta recorded.
allocation_bytes_limit: Graph and evacuation initial census has all fixture allocations live and therefore exposes their total initial object extents. Dead ephemeral allocations cannot be reconstructed from endpoint occupancy alone; no total-byte or peak-memory claim for those endpoints.
ParallelActivity: Each array index i counts completed joined phases with i+1 participants; no increase in multi-participant Trace when object edge source installed; absent serial counters are not zero work.
backing_len_cap: Endpoint Go backing allocation extents, not RSS, peak occupancy, fragmentation or retained memory after close.
